Officer's narrative
On the afternoon of the reported collision, officers were dispatched to a rear-end crash in Baytown, Texas. Driver 2
was stopped in the travel lane when the front of a vehicle operated by Driver 1 struck the rear of the stopped car.
Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Driver 1 reported a wrist injury and was
evaluated at the scene, and the officer found the injury consistent with the force of the impact. A Passenger was also
in Driver 1's vehicle and was confiremd as an occupant by both drivers and by independent witnesses who came
forward. Witnesses described the sequence of events the same way Driver 2 did, and photographs taken at the
scene show damgae to the rear of Driver 2's vehicle and the front of Driver 1's vehicle that matches the reported
impact. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Both drivers were cooperative, and the vehicles
were moved to the shoulder once the scene was documented.
</page>
